name: ZX_PARTY_DEDUCTIONS_F
description: This table stores information about tax deductions such as social security, alimony, etc for a particular tax party.

columns.name: TAX_DEDUCTION_ID
columns.description: Deduction identifier associated with a party.

columns.name: TAX_DEDUCTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of deduction such as for social secuirty, alimony, and dependents.

columns.name: NUM_OF_DEPENDENTS
columns.description: Number of dependents to be considered for deductions in withholding tax calculation.

columns.name: TAX_DEDUCTION_AMT
columns.description: Amount of deduction from the taxable basis for withholding tax calculation.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for the set of tax rules that determines the treatment of one or more taxes administered by a tax authority.

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax code for the classification of a charge imposed by a government through a fiscal or tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction code for a geographic area where a tax is levied by a specific tax authority.

columns.name: PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier of the party for which this deduction applies. Foreign key to ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Deduction record type, such as seeded or user defined.

columns.name: ALIMONY_BENEFICIARIES_INFO
columns.description: Concatenated information on beneficiaries of alimony for withholding tax deduction.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
